js: (()=>{const d=window.__dbg,g=d.scene.getObjectByName('bedShadow'),u=g.userData,f=u.footprint,ring=g.children.find(c=>c.isInstancedMesh);const M=new d.THREE.Matrix4(),P=new d.THREE.Vector3(),Q=new d.THREE.Quaternion(),S=new d.THREE.Vector3();let minD=1e9,maxD=-1e9,inside=0,maxTop=-1e9;const bladeH=(window.__dbg.grass?1:1);for(let i=0;i<ring.count;i++){ring.getMatrixAt(i,M);M.decompose(P,Q,S);const qx=Math.abs(P.x-f.cx)-f.hx, qz=Math.abs(P.z-f.cz)-f.hz;const sd=Math.hypot(Math.max(qx,0),Math.max(qz,0))+Math.min(Math.max(qx,qz),0);if(sd<minD)minD=sd;if(sd>maxD)maxD=sd;if(sd<0)inside++;const top=P.y+S.y*0.62;if(top>maxTop)maxTop=top;}return {minDistOutside:+minD.toFixed(4),maxDistOutside:+maxD.toFixed(4),bladesInsideBed:inside,highestBladeTop:+maxTop.toFixed(3),terrainNearBed:+d.terrainHeight(f.cx,f.cz).toFixed(3)};})()
